components.name: Evidence table
components.description: Bounded, keyboard-focusable evidence table with sticky column headings and access to every row.
components.html: SetupTimeframeMean R
components.css: .ds-evidence-scroll { max-height: 420px; overflow: auto; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface); }.ds-evidence-scroll:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }.ds-evidence-scroll table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; }.ds-evidence-scroll th { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1; padding: 9px 10px; text-align: left; font-size: 11px; background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--muted); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
